breakdown.description: Mass/volume conservation is violated for steady incompressible flow in constant area (Q cannot change from inlet to outlet).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the physical impossibility in the original prompt. Instead of using the contradictory flow rates, it applied the principle of mass conservation for steady, incompressible flow (Q_in = Q_out). It correctly stated that Q_out must equal Q_in (0.01 m³/s), thereby resolving the violation of conservation laws, which is precisely how the ground truth corrected the issue.
